title: JupiterCraft
description: JupiterCraft — a cozy, community-focused SMP featuring a player-driven economy, custom content, and a fresh take on survival.
body:
> FREE RANKS • CUSTOM CONTENT • SURVIVAL • PROGRESSION • ECONOMY

JupiterCraft is a community-focused survival SMP that stays true to the vanilla Minecraft experience while expanding gameplay with free progression ranks, custom content, and quality-of-life features.

Set in a future where humanity fled a collapsing Earth to the moons orbiting Jupiter, civilisation now survives on The Wild — a vast synthetic world created to resemble the Earth that was lost. As one of its inhabitants, you'll help shape the future through exploration, settlement building, trade, and community-driven progression.

The server features free earnable ranks, custom progression, levelled mobs, skills, land claiming, a player-driven economy, crates, cosmetics, leaderboards, and regular events — all designed to enhance survival without losing the core vanilla feel.

Whether you enjoy building, exploring, trading, grinding progression, or simply playing with friends, JupiterCraft offers a rewarding long-term survival experience with plenty of goals to work towards.
